name: Milk Puzzle
source:
Eleanor hates small talk and clings to routine. Then, one day, she did something different. She stopped to help – and that single act unlocked a door that would never close.

[From [url=https://margogaming.itch.io/milk-puzzle]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
埃莉诺讨厌闲聊，一成不变。然后，有一天，她做了一件不同的事情。她停下来帮忙——这一举动打开了一扇永远关不上的门。

[来自[url=https://margogaming.itch.io/milk-puzzle]Itch.io[/url]]
